# Parallelize cross-TU tests by isolating generated FileCheck crates

_2026-08-29 17:33:56_

Removed the nextest cross-tu max-threads=1 group after reproducing the race at full parallelism. The aggregate generated_cross_tu_filecheck test and dedicated fixture tests both called build_and_diff with the same fixture name, so each deleted and recreated the same target/cross-tu/<fixture>/rs crate and target/test-cache target directory. The observed failure was missing Cargo dep-info for ctype_locale while another test replaced that crate. Added a scope parameter to build_and_diff's work path and placed aggregate FileCheck artifacts under target/cross-tu/generated-cross-tu-filecheck/<fixture>; dedicated test paths stay unchanged for structural assertions. Repeated fully parallel cross-tu runs passed, and the full rewrites profile passed 110 tests in 38.6s.
